name: Headless Horseman: the Horseman, his head and his pumpkins are level 63 (#8361)
contract: #8361: the Headless Horseman (23682) was level 80, so level-60 players missed him. Like the Heroic and Mythic
bosses he is level 63, and so are his head (23775), the Pulsing Pumpkin (23694) and the Pumpkin Fiend (23545).
The Horseman and his head keep their health modifier 40 on level-63 expansion-1 stats: 4422 x 40 = 176880 for
the Paladin-class Horseman and 5527 x 40 = 221080 for the Warrior-class head, not the 40 health that
creature_classlevelstats' empty expansion-2 level-63 row would give.
